# text.delete_range

Delete text between start and end anchor patterns in files

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `backup` | boolean | No | - |
| `end_anchor` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `inclusive` | boolean | No | - |
| `path` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `regex` | boolean | No | - |
| `start_anchor` | string | **Yes** | - |

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd

- `file.updated`
